correctness.rationale: For every retained vertex subset of a unicyclic graph, C=X-Y+Z, with Z the full-cycle-survival indicator. Under exchangeable retention, the distributions of X, Z and the second moments of Y depend only on n, ell and the degree multiset. Classification of edges by 0,1,2 cycle endpoints yields the exact covariance difference. Hypergeometric coefficient positivity proves sharp quota k=ell+1. For n<=5, n-ell<=2 forces two distinct numbers of pendant leaves when B differs. At n=6 the explicit pairs have same degrees and ell=3 but B=2 vs 1. The standalone exact verifier independently enumerates all occupied subsets and 3–5 vertex connected unicyclic labeled graphs, matching formulas at each stated sampled parameter. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof.

originality.rationale: The scoped claim is the two-protocol exact variance contrast for degree-matched unicyclic networks, the sharp fixed quota cutoff and the six-vertex minimal witness. Inspected graph-based ecological connectivity, ecological aggregation and connected induced-subgraph extremal papers address different observables; circular runs work addresses pure cycles, and indexed bond-percolation covariance covers a distinct model. No stronger statement was found in the published scientific database and primary-literature queries. Source access and unknown equivalent graph-polynomial identities remain acknowledged limitations.

value.rationale: Habitat fragmentation is naturally measured by connected surviving-patch count. Networks sharing size, degree multiset, cycle length, and even the full mean fragmentation curve can retain distinct population variances; the difference precisely resolves how many branches depart directly from the loop. The exact n=6 minimal obstruction and k=ell+1 minimal fixed-census budget specify concrete study-design identifiability boundaries. The observation applies to both independent occupancy and quota-constrained occupancy; it is not merely a rewritten textbook expectation or an arbitrary finite slice. Practical robustness under noise is not claimed.
